import json
d=json.load(open(var_call_3))
P={p['_id']:p for p in d}
b=P['BK-M68B-38']
inv=sum(int(i['quantity']) for i in b['inventory'])
seen=set();bought=[]
def walk(pn,lvl):
    for c in P[pn]['bom']:
        if c['end_date'] not in ('None',None): continue
        cn=c['component_number']
        if cn in seen: continue
        seen.add(cn)
        q=P.get(cn)
        if q is None: continue
        lt=[int(v['average_lead_time']) for v in q['vendors']]
        if lt: bought.append((cn,q['name'],q['make_flag'],max(lt),lvl))
        walk(cn,lvl+1)
walk('BK-M68B-38',1)
bought.sort(key=lambda x:-x[3])
print('__RESULT__:')
print(json.dumps({'name':b['name'],'lp':b['list_price'],'inv':b['inventory'],'tot':inv,'bought':bought[:8],'nb':len(bought)}))
